pairs.why: A's dome, thick dark rim and fuller disc body have the chunky toy-like volume of the real cards, while B is a thinner, flatter plate.
A has the real locker's stubby feet, wide chunky body and rounded top edges, while B is taller and slimmer on tall legs with sharper, thinner edges.
A's wide, blocky body with a flat slab base and flat-faced panels matches the real pump's chunky proportions, while B is a taller, narrower rounded tube.
Both clocks have the same round outline, rim thickness and hand layout, so shape gives no reason to choose.
B's gloves are big and fat and fill the frame like the real pair, while A's are smaller with large cuffs.
A's sphere on a thick, solid brass base reads as chunky like the real objects, while B's thin curly feet are fussy.
A has the real light's thick barrel and heavy yoke at a similar scale, while B is a small, thin-lined model.
